{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Clean the revenue column: remove commas and convert to float
# Note: This is safe because the documentation says it has thousands separators
# and the auto-check confirmed it's text
data['revenue_clean'] = data['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter for completed orders only
completed_only = data[data['status'] == 'completed']

# Total revenue from completed orders
total_revenue_completed = completed_only['revenue_clean'].sum()

# Print the result
total_revenue_completed"}
